featureShowcases.heading: Your Studio at a Glance
featureShowcases.summary: Start with a clear overview of your apps, revenue and connected services.
featureShowcases.body: StudioDash brings the information you use to run your apps into one workspace. See how your portfolio is performing, check revenue, review connected services and quickly identify anything that needs attention. When you want more detail, move directly from the dashboard into dedicated analytics and reporting views.
bullets: See key performance information across your app portfolio.
Keep track of App Store activity and app status.
Check the health of connected services and recent updates.
Move quickly from the overview into detailed analytics.

image.alt: StudioDash dashboard showing app portfolio performance, revenue and connected services
image.caption: See the important parts of your studio from one dashboard.

sections.heading: One Dashboard for Your Studio
paragraphs: Running apps often means checking several different services just to understand how the business is performing. App Store information may be in one place, advertising revenue in another, website analytics somewhere else, with additional dashboards for search and other services.
StudioDash brings supported information together into one workspace, giving you a faster way to understand what is happening across your portfolio before deciding where you need to look more closely.

sections.heading: See the Bigger Picture
paragraphs: Individual numbers are more useful when they have context. StudioDash is designed to help you see relationships between your apps, their performance and the different sources contributing to your studio.
Instead of treating downloads, revenue, advertising and website activity as completely separate reports, StudioDash provides a central starting point for understanding your overall performance.

sections.heading: What You Can Monitor
paragraphs: The information available in StudioDash grows with the services you connect. Your dashboard focuses on useful signals rather than requiring you to work through every report provided by each individual platform.
bullets: App portfolio and App Store status.
Downloads and sales information where available.
Revenue from connected app and advertising sources.
Website and analytics performance from supported services.

sections.heading: Keep Revenue Visible
paragraphs: StudioDash keeps commercial performance visible alongside your other app information. This makes it easier to understand not only whether an app is being downloaded or used, but whether it is contributing revenue to your studio.
For deeper analysis, the dedicated revenue views let you explore performance over different periods and understand how connected revenue sources contribute to your results.

sections.heading: Understand Performance Over Time
paragraphs: A single day's figures rarely tell the whole story. StudioDash lets you review information across different reporting periods so you can distinguish short-term changes from longer-term trends.

Historical information already collected by StudioDash can be reused when changing views and reporting periods, helping you explore your data without repeatedly requesting the same information from connected services.

sections.heading: Know When Something Needs Attention
paragraphs: A missing number does not always mean something is wrong. A provider may not have published new information yet, an integration may need attention, or there may simply be no activity for the selected period.
StudioDash keeps the state of connected services visible so you can quickly see whether your data is updating normally and identify integrations that may need your attention.

sections.heading: Bring Your Developer Services Together
paragraphs: StudioDash is built around connected services rather than a single source of information. App Store, advertising, analytics, website and search services can contribute different parts of the picture.
You choose which supported services to connect, allowing StudioDash to become a dashboard for the tools that are relevant to your own apps and studio.

sections.heading: Built for the Daily Check-In
paragraphs: StudioDash is designed to answer the first questions you are likely to have when checking your apps: Is revenue moving? Are my apps performing normally? Has anything changed? Are my connected services healthy?

The dashboard gives you that starting point without requiring a tour through multiple external services. When something deserves more attention, the detailed views provide the next level of information.

sections.heading: Data Ready When You Need It
paragraphs: On Mac, StudioDash can keep supported provider information updated in the background. This means useful information can already be available when you return to the dashboard rather than every session beginning with a manual refresh.
You can still request fresh information manually whenever you need to check for newly available data.
